companies.name: Atlas
companies.reason: Atlas was recently selected as part of the NBA's fifth Launchpad incubator cohort. The company focuses on brain-sensing wearables that aim to enhance performance and athlete safety. This selection highlights its potential impact on athlete health and sports technology advancements.

companies.name: Bolt6
companies.reason: Bolt6 has been recognized as one of the most innovative sports tech companies in a recent list published by Sports Business Journal. The company specializes in improving sports analytics and performance, making significant strides in how teams leverage data for strategy and player development.

companies.name: Mojo Sports
companies.reason: Mojo Sports was listed among the most innovative companies in sports for 2023. The company is transforming how fans engage with sports through its platform, which allows for real-time interaction and community engagement, emphasizing the growing trend of digitalization in sports fandom.
